toegepas.voor: het my pa hulle een vir een aangesteek
toegepas.na: het my pa die lampies een vir een aangesteek
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'my pa hulle' reads as the colloquial 'Pa-hulle' (Dad and the others), so the pronoun is ambiguous; naming the lamps removes the misreading.
toegepas.fout: 'my pa hulle' can be read as the common Afrikaans 'my pa-hulle' (Dad and the others), so who lit the lamps is unclear on a first reading.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the lamps removes a real stumble without changing who does what; the extra 'lampies' a few sentences later is tolerable.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'soet koek' is an unnatural pairing in Afrikaans (it suggests 'soetkoekies' misspelt); cake is already understood as sweet.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'soet koek' is unremarkable in a child's story voice, and dropping 'soet' loses a detail about the Eid treat rather than fixing a fault.

vlae.teks: Die Adams-gesin woon reg oorkant ons, en hulle vas elke jaar 'n hele maand lank.
vlae.rede: The protected sentence says only the adults fast and must not be widened to the family, yet this earlier sentence already says the whole family ('hulle', the Adams-gesin) fasts; the writer should decide whether this sentence makes the claim the protection was meant to prevent. Not a language fix, so not changed.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: is vroeg die oggend moskee toe
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Vroegoggend' is the natural Afrikaans form; 'vroeg die oggend' reads as a translation.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Vroeg die oggend' is natural Afrikaans for early that morning, so the swap is lateral and loses the pointer to that day.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Later daardie dag' is the idiomatic way to refer back to a day already named.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Later die dag' is an ordinary idiomatic narrative phrase; 'later daardie dag' only reads differently.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: waarop elke kossoort sy eie plek kry
laat_vaar_vorige.na: waarop elke kossoort sy eie plek gehad het
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The present tense 'kry' breaks the past-tense narration of the paragraph.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The present tense describes what the plate is for in general, which is acceptable, and 'gehad het' is clumsier and narrows that sense.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Platbrood' is written as one compound word.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Plat brood' is a correct adjective-plus-noun description for a Grade 5 reader; making it a compound is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Daardie oggend' makes clear that this is the morning of Christmas Day.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Die oggend' already reads naturally as that morning in narration, and 'daardie' adds no clearer referent.
